notes: Choose wired or wireless brew by weight during setup or under Machine → BBW paddle connection in the paired web interface. Wireless needs a verified machine Bluetooth connection, the original paddle circuit independent of Shotdeck, and acceptance of the risk notice. Return the paddle to Stop and check the flow after every wireless shot.
Connect your La Marzocco machine over Bluetooth with a step-by-step guide in the web interface. The guide ends with a connection check.
Find machine settings faster. The Machine page opens on an overview, and each group of settings has its own section.
Shot history shows whether a brew-by-weight shot used the wired or the wireless paddle connection.

Grind-by-Sync reports only shots that Shotdeck ends at the target to the E64. Save the E64 owner password once to read the grinder receipt in shot details. Enabling Grind-by-Sync adds the Mahlkönig E64 WS to your grinders.
Fixed an Acaia decoding error that could show a sudden large weight jump.
